releases.notes:
NamServerSwitcher 1.1.1 standardizes the project name across GitHub, Modrinth, the in-game mod list, documentation, and distributable filenames.

Download only the jar matching your exact Minecraft version. Fabric API and Cloth Config are required; Mod Menu is optional. Use Java 21 for Minecraft 1.21.x and Java 25 for 26.x.

All 15 exact-version builds and nine scroll-model tests per target passed. Jar metadata, embedded icon, license, mappings namespace, Java class version, and hashes were verified. Live multiplayer and GUI behavior have not been manually tested on every target.

The internal `serverswitcher` mod ID and configuration path remain unchanged for upgrade compatibility.

Author: nattapat2871 (https://nattapat2871.me). MIT-licensed fork of Progem4041/ServersSwitcher with retained attribution. Compatibility code, documentation, and bundled icon were AI-assisted; no runtime AI service is used.

releases.notes: Fifteen exact-version Fabric builds. Download only the jar matching your Minecraft version, plus Fabric API and Cloth Config for that version. Java 21 for 1.21.x; Java 25 for 26.x. Mod Menu is optional; Meteor is not required. Mouse-wheel scrolling, draggable scrollbar, and closing the old connection before joining are included. All 15 builds and nine scroll-model tests per target passed. Jar namespaces, class versions, metadata, and hashes were verified. Live multiplayer and mouse behavior have not been manually tested across all targets. Author: nattapat2871 (https://nattapat2871.me). MIT fork of Progem4041/ServersSwitcher with retained attribution. Compatibility code, documentation, and bundled icon were AI-assisted; no runtime AI service is used.
